title: A test is skipped with no expiry: reason="temporarily disabled 2026-05-02 - flaky?"

root_cause.mechanism: A skip with no expiry is a deleted test that nobody decided to delete: it never runs again and no one is told.

evidence: eval/fixtures/pricer_rev_b/test_pricer.py:17 — skip marker with reason 'reason="temporarily disabled 2026-05-02 - flaky?"'; no date or expiry in the reason
found by a regular expression over the test files, not by a model

withdrawn by the skip scan 2026-11-27: the suite collects nothing under the top-level directory of eval/fixtures/pricer_rev_b/test_pricer.py (this run's test-id ledger, every gate green), and each cited line is a decorator, which pytest collects and then skips — a skip outside the suite removes no coverage it has
narrative: The skip scan that filed this read the same lines again and no longer files them. The finding was a false positive of the rule as it then stood, and it stays on the record as one.
